name: Eurocrane (China) Co., Ltd.
summary: Eurocrane (China) Co., Ltd., based in Suzhou, China, and established in 2002, operates as a global provider and manufacturer of advanced lifting and material handling solutions. Its comprehensive product portfolio includes a diverse range of cranes such as overhead, gantry, jib, flexible girder, and specialized models for clean room or explosion-proof environments. Additionally, the company supplies electric hoists, transmission systems, and various components for engineering machinery. Beyond its product offerings, Eurocrane provides essential services, encompassing equipment installation, emergency maintenance, inspection, system upgrades, technical training, and the supply of spare parts. The company's offerings are widely utilized across a broad spectrum of industries, including heavy manufacturing, transportation and logistics, energy (such as nuclear and wind power), automotive, marine, aerospace, defense, and specialized sectors like food processing, pharmaceuticals, metallurgy, petrochemicals, and waste management.
